name: benchmark-pubmedQA_tb-IFT
description: A variant of the PubMedQA clinical question-answering dataset hosted on Hugging Face (TTKhosa/benchmark-pubmedQA_tb-IFT). It measures models' ability to answer biomedical research questions (often framed as yes/no/maybe) grounded in PubMed abstracts and associated evidence. The dataset is aimed at evaluating domain-specific medical reasoning and answering performance.
evaluation_method: accuracy (often combined with F1 for class balance)
reputation: Derived from the well-known PubMedQA corpus; widely recognized in biomedical NLP but this particular HF variant has moderate, niche usage.
